title: The delivery blob deadline bounds each Git read, not the manifest work between reads
description: The delivery blob deadline bounds each Git read, not the manifest work between reads
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-change-144 keeps the Git read deadline unchanged, and the whole-scope read it replaced bounded only Git's own I/O; the delivery blob stream armed one deadline for its whole life, so the acceptance manifest's config, owner and manifest work between reads counted against Git (#991)
acceptance_criteria: a delivery blob stream whose caller spends longer than the Git deadline between two reads still reads the second blob; a read that Git itself stalls past the deadline is still killed and reported as a deadline failure

answers.constraints: the per-object bound, the path-count bound and the 120 s Git read deadline are unchanged; the acceptance manifest and input digest stay byte-identical
